Item: Window navigation / feature-disable via a mid-freeze real E2E
Rationale: Requires an active real freeze against a real memory address in a real target process; no fixture executable with a known writable/discoverable address exists in this repo. Attempting this in one session risked exactly the 'unreliable test infrastructure for a security-critical write-authorization surface' concern already raised in Gate 2. Feature-disable's flag-gate mechanism remains covered by feature-disable-cleanup.test.ts (fake-driven, now wired into test:live-memory) plus real settings storage/read-back covered elsewhere; window-identity/navigation remains covered by trusted-sender-registry.test.ts and session-cleanup-on-destroy.test.ts (fake-driven, both already wired). Flagged as an owner decision, not silently resolved.

Because the harness's single trusted window's renderer was already crashed by the prior scenario (a second ad-hoc BrowserWindow is not registered in trusted-sender-registry.ts and cannot exercise privileged IPC), the shutdown scenario certifies 'will-quit exits cleanly, no hang' after a full session lifecycle rather than 'an IPC-attached session was active at the exact instant of quit.' Disclosed here rather than staged to look otherwise.
